rows.Original Decision: The product is a multi-tenant, multilingual Hospitality Operating System for cafés, restaurants, bakeries, bars, food courts, hotel outlets and related hospitality operators.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: The product is a multi-tenant, multilingual Hospitality Operating System for cafés, restaurants, bakeries, bars, food courts, hotel outlets and related hospitality operators.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: The product is designed for internal use and commercial sale to independent outlets, groups, franchises and enterprise operators.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: The product is designed for internal use and commercial sale to independent outlets, groups, franchises and enterprise operators.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: HospitalityOS is a working codename only; product name, trademarks and customer-facing branding are configurable and not hard-coded.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: HospitalityOS is a working codename only; product name, trademarks and customer-facing branding are configurable and not hard-coded.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: The architecture must support 10–20 years of additive evolution without requiring a customer-platform rebuild.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: The architecture must support 10–20 years of additive evolution without requiring a customer-platform rebuild.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Start as a modular monolith with strict domain boundaries, versioned contracts and reliable events; do not begin with premature microservices.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Start as a modular monolith with strict domain boundaries, versioned contracts and reliable events; do not begin with premature microservices.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: All business capabilities are exposed through versioned APIs; frontends do not perform direct business writes to the database.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: All business capabilities are exposed through versioned APIs; frontends do not perform direct business writes to the database.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: The hierarchy is platform → tenant → brand → legal entity → outlet → service area → station/table/device, with scopes configurable per tenant.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: The hierarchy is platform → tenant → brand → legal entity → outlet → service area → station/table/device, with scopes configurable per tenant.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Every tenant can operate without Horeca Addis, without another supplier connector and without platform-owned payment services.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Every tenant can operate without Horeca Addis, without another supplier connector and without platform-owned payment services.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: A differently branded second tenant must be included in automated tests and demonstration data to prove isolation and neutrality.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: A differently branded second tenant must be included in automated tests and demonstration data to prove isolation and neutrality.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: English, Amharic, Arabic, French, Simplified Chinese and Hindi are first-class customer launch languages. Each outlet controls its enabled languages, display order and default; Arabic includes true right-to-left behavior. Staff and back-office applications launch in English.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: English, Amharic and Arabic are the first-class customer launch languages. Arabic uses true right-to-left layout. Each outlet may order or disable launch languages only after approved translations remain complete.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Canonical records are language-neutral and use customer translation records with fallback, completeness and approval controls; no duplicated menu per language. Customer interfaces are fully localized, while staff and back-office interfaces are English-first but translation-ready.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Canonical records are language-neutral and use customer translation records with fallback, completeness and approval controls; no duplicated menu per language. Customer interfaces are fully localized, while staff and back-office interfaces are English-first but translation-ready.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: A customer may browse and order as a guest; loyalty registration must never block ordinary service.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: A customer may browse and order as a guest; loyalty registration must never block ordinary service.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Phone number is the primary loyalty identity, with OTP through a provider adapter; verified email may be linked to the same user.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Phase 1 is guest-first. Phone number remains the preferred future customer identity for loyalty/account features, which activate after the Phase 1 service core is approved.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Table QR codes use opaque signed references and revocable versions; raw sequential table IDs are not exposed.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Table QR codes use opaque signed references and revocable versions; raw sequential table IDs are not exposed.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: A table session is separate from carts, orders, checks and payments and may contain multiple participants, devices and orders.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: A table session is separate from carts, orders, checks and payments and may contain multiple participants, devices and orders.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Multiple customers at one table can maintain personal or shared carts, place separate orders and settle together or separately.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Multiple customers at one table can maintain personal or shared carts, place separate orders and settle together or separately.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: After language and guest/loyalty choice, the customer can view the menu, call a waiter or view an active table session.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: After language and guest/loyalty choice, the customer can view the menu, call a waiter or view an active table session.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Every customer service request has a type, target role, assignment, acknowledgement timer, escalation and closure evidence.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Every customer service request has a type, target role, assignment, acknowledgement timer, escalation and closure evidence.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Dine-in QR, waiter-entered dine-in, counter/POS, pickup and delivery use one shared order engine with channel-specific policies.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Phase 1 implements dine-in QR, waiter-entered dine-in and counter/POS through one order engine. Pickup and delivery remain additive channel contracts and are not built until the dine-in release is approved.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Kiosk, marketplace, room service, catering, drive-through and voice/AI ordering are additive channel adapters, not separate order systems.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Kiosk, marketplace, room service, catering, drive-through and voice/AI ordering are additive channel adapters, not separate order systems.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Submitted orders and accepted order lines are not silently overwritten; changes use additions, authorized amendments, cancellations, voids or reversals.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Submitted orders and accepted order lines are not silently overwritten; changes use additions, authorized amendments, cancellations, voids or reversals.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Order, fulfillment ticket, check/bill, payment, stock movement and accounting entry are separate linked records.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Order, fulfillment ticket, check/bill, payment, stock movement and accounting entry are separate linked records.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Each order line is routed to one or more production stations by a versioned preparation profile; one order may produce multiple tickets.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Each order line is routed to one or more production stations by a versioned preparation profile; one order may produce multiple tickets.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Customer-facing statuses are simplified and translated in the order/session language, which is snapshotted for communications and support; internal preparation and service statuses remain operationally detailed and launch in English.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Customer-facing statuses are simplified and translated in the order/session language, which is snapshotted for communications and support; internal preparation and service statuses remain operationally detailed and launch in English.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Dine-in items support fire-now, hold and course sequencing; the customer cannot bypass outlet policies for controlled courses.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Dine-in items support fire-now, hold and course sequencing; the customer cannot bypass outlet policies for controlled courses.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Availability is checked when displaying the menu and revalidated when an order is submitted; stale availability never guarantees fulfillment.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Availability is checked when displaying the menu and revalidated when an order is submitted; stale availability never guarantees fulfillment.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: A menu item is distinct from a recipe, sellable variant, price, modifier set and outlet availability record.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: A menu item is distinct from a recipe, sellable variant, price, modifier set and outlet availability record.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Customer-visible ingredient descriptions are separate from confidential operational recipes and quantities.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Customer-visible ingredient descriptions are separate from confidential operational recipes and quantities.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Allergen information is structured, translated, versioned and shown with approved text plus universal supporting icons; an allergy declaration triggers a prominent confirmation and kitchen alert, not a medical guarantee. Required safety translation gaps block publication in that language.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Allergen information is structured, translated, versioned and shown with approved text plus universal supporting icons; an allergy declaration triggers a prominent confirmation and kitchen alert, not a medical guarantee. Required safety translation gaps block publication in that language.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Vegetarian, vegan, fasting, halal and other labels are configurable claims with definitions and approval responsibility per tenant and jurisdiction.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Vegetarian, vegan, fasting, halal and other labels are configurable claims with definitions and approval responsibility per tenant and jurisdiction.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Stock consumption and costing reference the recipe/BOM version effective when the order line was accepted or fulfilled.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Stock consumption and costing reference the recipe/BOM version effective when the order line was accepted or fulfilled.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Modifiers use explicit min/max, included quantity, price delta, preparation effect, allergen effect and recipe effect.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Modifiers use explicit min/max, included quantity, price delta, preparation effect, allergen effect and recipe effect.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Menus, prices and availability can vary by outlet, channel, daypart, date, service area and fulfillment method.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Menus, prices and availability can vary by outlet, channel, daypart, date, service area and fulfillment method.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Pickup supports branch selection, now/scheduled slots, promised-ready time, collection code and customer-arrived notification.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Pickup supports branch selection, now/scheduled slots, promised-ready time, collection code and customer-arrived notification.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Phase 1 delivery supports zones/polygons, fees, minimums, GPS pin plus landmarks, manual dispatch, own-driver or manual third-party handoff, COD and proof.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Phase 1 delivery supports zones/polygons, fees, minimums, GPS pin plus landmarks, manual dispatch, own-driver or manual third-party handoff, COD and proof.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Automatic batching, route optimization, marketplace aggregation and fully automated courier APIs are later modules using the same delivery domain.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Automatic batching, route optimization, marketplace aggregation and fully automated courier APIs are later modules using the same delivery domain.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Preparation status and delivery status remain separate; a ready order may still be awaiting a driver.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Preparation status and delivery status remain separate; a ready order may still be awaiting a driver.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Delivery addresses support map coordinates, landmark, building/floor/unit and free-text instructions; formal street address is not mandatory.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Delivery addresses support map coordinates, landmark, building/floor/unit and free-text instructions; formal street address is not mandatory.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Payments use provider adapters and tokenized references; raw card data is never stored by the platform.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Payments use provider adapters and tokenized references; raw card data is never stored by the platform.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Cash, external card terminal, mobile/payment-link/QR, loyalty credit, gift value, corporate account and permitted mixed tender are modeled separately.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Cash, external card-terminal result recording and verified Telebirr/CBE Birr proof confirmation are live pilot paths. Direct online-provider APIs remain adapter/simulator-only until contracted and credentialed. Raw card processing is prohibited and receipts state the actual method.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: A dine-in customer may request cash/card collection; staff receives a routed, timed payment-service request.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: A dine-in customer may request cash/card collection; staff receives a routed, timed payment-service request.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Checks can be split by item, person, amount or equal share; partial payments and multiple tenders are supported without changing the original order history.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Checks can be split by item, person, amount or equal share; partial payments and multiple tenders are supported without changing the original order history.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Tips, gratuities, service charges, taxes, packaging and delivery fees are separate configurable financial components.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: The bill, optional tip, service charge, tax and every other fee are distinct records and presentation lines. The payment screen contains a separate optional Tip box; no tip is selected by default; total paid equals bill settlement plus separately recorded tip.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Refunds, voids, discounts and complimentary items require configurable permissions, reason codes and audit; thresholds can require approval.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Refunds, voids, discounts and complimentary items require configurable permissions, reason codes and audit; thresholds can require approval.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Cash drawers and cashier shifts have opening float, collections, payouts, expected balance, actual count and variance approval.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Cash drawers and cashier shifts have opening float, collections, payouts, expected balance, actual count and variance approval.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: The platform supports digital and printed customer receipts in the order language, reprints with attribution, English internal documents and fiscal adapter hooks.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: The platform supports digital and printed customer receipts in the order language, reprints with attribution, English internal documents and fiscal adapter hooks.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Inventory changes are recorded in an append-only stock ledger with lot/location/UOM context; corrections use reversals or adjustment events.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Inventory changes are recorded in an append-only stock ledger with lot/location/UOM context; corrections use reversals or adjustment events.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Negative stock is blocked by default; any permitted override is tenant policy, role restricted, reasoned and visibly exceptional.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Negative stock is blocked by default; any permitted override is tenant policy, role restricted, reasoned and visibly exceptional.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Default recipe consumption occurs at fulfillment completion, with configurable reservation/commit timing and explicit waste/rework adjustments.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Default recipe consumption occurs at fulfillment completion, with configurable reservation/commit timing and explicit waste/rework adjustments.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Pickup and delivery packaging is modeled as stock and may be costed or charged separately.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Pickup and delivery packaging is modeled as stock and may be costed or charged separately.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Waste, spoilage, tasting, staff meal, promotion and complimentary consumption use distinct reasoned stock events.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Waste, spoilage, tasting, staff meal, promotion and complimentary consumption use distinct reasoned stock events.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Procurement supports manual suppliers and a generic supplier integration hub; no supplier owns the restaurant’s internal item identity.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Procurement supports manual suppliers and a generic supplier integration hub; no supplier owns the restaurant’s internal item identity.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Internal ingredients/items map to zero or more supplier SKUs with pack/UOM conversions, validity dates, priority and substitution rules.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Internal ingredients/items map to zero or more supplier SKUs with pack/UOM conversions, validity dates, priority and substitution rules.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: The Horeca Addis connector is optional, disabled by default and enabled by tenant/outlet entitlement and configuration.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: The Horeca Addis connector is optional, disabled by default and enabled by tenant/outlet entitlement and configuration.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: The connector contract and simulator exist in Phase 1; basic transactional integration activates in Phase 2 and intelligent reordering in Phase 3.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: The connector contract and simulator exist in Phase 1; basic transactional integration activates in Phase 2 and intelligent reordering in Phase 3.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: The restaurant platform continues to operate if Horeca Addis is disconnected or unavailable and can convert drafts to manual supplier orders.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: The restaurant platform continues to operate if Horeca Addis is disconnected or unavailable and can convert drafts to manual supplier orders.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: A connected supplier order requires online validation of current price, availability, pack, minimums, account status and delivery slot before final submission.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: A connected supplier order requires online validation of current price, availability, pack, minimums, account status and delivery slot before final submission.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Automated or forecast-based reorders create recommendations/drafts; a human or configured approval workflow authorizes purchase commitment.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Automated or forecast-based reorders create recommendations/drafts; a human or configured approval workflow authorizes purchase commitment.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Purchase order, supplier acknowledgement, delivery, goods receipt, discrepancy, return/claim, supplier invoice and payment are distinct linked records.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Purchase order, supplier acknowledgement, delivery, goods receipt, discrepancy, return/claim, supplier invoice and payment are distinct linked records.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: The native accounting foundation uses double-entry journals, immutable postings, reversals, periods, cost centers and auditable subledgers.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: The native accounting foundation uses double-entry journals, immutable postings, reversals, periods, cost centers and auditable subledgers.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Phase 1 includes sales posting, cash/bank/payment clearing, tax/service/tip components, inventory/COGS hooks, cash reconciliation and basic P&L evidence.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Phase 1 records immutable operational checks, payments, refunds, tips, cash shifts and settlement summaries. It does not implement a general ledger, AP, AR, inventory accounting, COGS or financial statements.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Full AP, AR, purchasing, bank reconciliation, budgets, period close, inventory valuation and outlet/legal-entity reporting activate in Phase 2.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Full AP, AR, purchasing, bank reconciliation, budgets, period close, inventory valuation and outlet/legal-entity reporting activate in Phase 2.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: External accounting/fiscal systems connect through adapters and a system-of-record registry; duplicate authoritative ledgers are prohibited.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: External accounting/fiscal systems connect through adapters and a system-of-record registry; duplicate authoritative ledgers are prohibited.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Employee, assignment, role, skill, shift, clocking and attendance foundations exist in Phase 1.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Phase 1 includes staff identities, outlet memberships, roles and terminal access only. Employee records, rosters, clocking, attendance and workforce management activate in Phase 2.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Full payroll is a Phase 3 country package; the core stores payroll inputs and approved results without hard-coding one country’s law.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Full payroll is a Phase 3 country package; the core stores payroll inputs and approved results without hard-coding one country’s law.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Loyalty is optional per tenant and supports phone-based membership, points/tiers/rewards, consent, balances and immutable earn/redeem events.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Loyalty is optional per tenant and supports phone-based membership, points/tiers/rewards, consent, balances and immutable earn/redeem events.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Guest sessions minimize personal data; loyalty and delivery PII are purpose-limited, consented, access-controlled and separately protected.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Guest sessions minimize personal data; loyalty and delivery PII are purpose-limited, consented, access-controlled and separately protected.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Promotions are rule-driven, versioned and conflict-resolved; staff cannot invent uncontrolled discounts at checkout.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Promotions are rule-driven, versioned and conflict-resolved; staff cannot invent uncontrolled discounts at checkout.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Customer-facing QR, pickup, delivery, loyalty and online payments are online-first and are not required to operate during an internet outage.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: The customer QR experience is cloud-connected by default but continues over restaurant Wi-Fi during outage using the same per-outlet public hostname, split-horizon DNS and public-trust TLS.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Waiter/POS, KDS/bar/expo, local printing, table service, cash settlement and selected stock events are offline-capable in resilient outlet mode.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Customer QR ordering, waiter/POS, KDS/bar/expo, printing, table service, bills, separate tips, cash, external-terminal recording and verified Telebirr/CBE Birr proof confirmation continue on the outlet network during outage when the underlying provider result can be verified.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Small outlets may use cloud-only mode; resilient edge is an optional deployment profile, not mandatory for every tenant.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: A production Phase 1 outlet includes the focused local continuity node. Cloud-only mode is allowed only for development, demonstration or explicitly non-production evaluation.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: During outage, the outlet edge node is authoritative for approved local operational domains and synchronizes through application events/commands after reconnection.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: The outlet node is the authoritative writer for active dine-in operations. Cloud forwarding depends on a valid bidirectional reachability lease and the same durable monotonic signed authority sequence.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Direct database replication is not the business synchronization mechanism; use transactional outbox/inbox, ordered cursors, idempotency and explicit conflicts.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Direct database replication is not the business synchronization mechanism; use transactional outbox/inbox, ordered cursors, idempotency and explicit conflicts.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Actions requiring live external authority—online payment, connected supplier commitment, central credit approval or unavailable cloud-only data—are blocked or queued transparently.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: During outage, direct online-provider payments and other external-authority actions are unavailable or queued. Cash, external-terminal recording and verified Telebirr/CBE Birr proof confirmation may continue; unverified claims remain pending.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Kitchen/bar/receipt printing has a local print agent, printer routing, retry/deduplication and operator-visible failure handling.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Kitchen/bar/receipt printing has a local print agent, printer routing, retry/deduplication and operator-visible failure handling.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Staff uses phone/email identity with secure sessions; trusted local terminals may offer quick PIN only for low-risk actions with step-up for sensitive work.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Staff uses phone/email identity with secure sessions; trusted local terminals may offer quick PIN only for low-risk actions with step-up for sensitive work.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Permissions are deny-by-default and scoped by tenant, legal entity, outlet, role, resource and action; server-side enforcement is mandatory.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Permissions are deny-by-default and scoped by tenant, legal entity, outlet, role, resource and action; server-side enforcement is mandatory.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: High-risk finance, stock, payroll, refund and configuration actions support maker-checker and prevent self-approval where configured.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: High-risk finance, stock, payroll, refund and configuration actions support maker-checker and prevent self-approval where configured.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Security, commercial, stock, finance, menu, permission, sync and administrative events are append-only and attributable to actor, terminal, source and correlation.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Security, commercial, stock, finance, menu, permission, sync and administrative events are append-only and attributable to actor, terminal, source and correlation.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Transactional records are retained according to tenant/jurisdiction policy; ordinary users cannot hard-delete completed commercial or financial records.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Transactional records are retained according to tenant/jurisdiction policy; ordinary users cannot hard-delete completed commercial or financial records.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Uploads are private by default, type/size validated, safely named, malware-scannable, hash recorded and served through authorized signed access.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Uploads are private by default, type/size validated, safely named, malware-scannable, hash recorded and served through authorized signed access.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Structured logs, traces, metrics, health checks, business alerts and audit are distinct; secrets and sensitive payment/PII data are redacted.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Structured logs, traces, metrics, health checks, business alerts and audit are distinct; secrets and sensitive payment/PII data are redacted.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Development, CI/test, staging and production are separate; containers and adapters support managed cloud and future private/on-prem deployment.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Development, CI/test, staging and production are separate; containers and adapters support managed cloud and future private/on-prem deployment.
rows.Rationale: Reconciled to Source of Truth v2.0.2.

rows.Original Decision: Database and file backups, encrypted off-site copies, restore drills, recovery objectives and edge/cloud reconciliation are part of completion.
rows.v2.0.3 Decision: Database and file backups, encrypted off-site copies, restore drills, recovery objectives and edge/cloud reconciliation are part of completion.
